# DatIQ: The Unified Web Intelligence Platform
> DatIQ: The Unified Web Intelligence Platform. It reads the public web into structured data, runs the workflow that turns that data into a finished brief or a scored account list, watches competitors on a cadence, and routes what matters into Slack, email, a webhook or a CRM. Extraction is the foundation, not the product. No code required.
> Tagline: Intelligence from Web.

## Disambiguation
DatIQ (this product) is a no-code web intelligence platform for extracting structured data from any public URL. It is NOT related to:
- "DAT iQ" / "DATiQ" — a freight rate intelligence product by IntelliTrans / Trimble (North American trucking market)
- "DAT" (without "iQ") — the parent DAT freight & load-board company
- "Data IQ" / "DataIQ" — a generic analytics consultancy term, used by multiple unrelated firms

DatIQ.app is the canonical product. The brand is styled "DatIQ" (one word, capital I, capital Q).

## What DatIQ Does
DatIQ runs a five-step loop over the public web: READ (extract structured data from any public page), REASON (run a workflow template that turns those fields into a finished artefact such as an account brief or a competitive comparison), WATCH (re-read chosen pages on a cadence and classify what changed), ACT (route the changes that matter into Slack, email, a webhook or a CRM), and SHARE (publish any result as a report at its own link with a chosen visibility level).

Users can stop at step one — paste a URL and receive headings, links, an AI summary, contacts, pricing and any custom field described in plain English — but the platform exists to remove the work between having data and having a decision.

Governing rule: every field DatIQ returns is OBSERVED (read off a page, with the page and supporting quote recorded), INFERRED (derived and explicitly labelled), or ABSENT. Nothing is invented and no field is filled with a plausible default. Every score therefore carries a COVERAGE figure, and an unmeasured signal is excluded with its weight redistributed rather than scored as zero.

## Core Capabilities
- Web extraction: headings H1–H6, all internal/external links, metadata
- AI summary: plain-language overview of any page
- Custom extraction: describe any field in English, AI locates and structures it
- Domain mapping: discover every indexed URL on a site
- Contact extraction: surface leadership names, email addresses, social profiles
- Pricing extraction: structured pricing tiers from any pricing page
- Content generation: SEO outlines, competitive briefs, email drafts from saved pages
- Export as CSV, Excel (.xls), PDF, Markdown or JSON, from one shared Export menu with Download / Copy / Send sections
- Billing records: every payment issues a numbered, itemized invoice or receipt, emailed as a PDF and available to view, download, or re-send from the Account screen
- Discoverability audits: score any URL for classic search (SEO), answer engines (AEO) and generative engines (GEO) in one run, across four pillars — Answer Clarity, Entity Authority, Structural Hierarchy, Technical Accessibility
- Prioritised remediation with copy-ready constructs: FAQPage and Organization JSON-LD generated from the page's own visible content, 40-60 word answer blocks, corrected heading outlines, robots.txt entries for answer-engine crawlers
- Re-audit and compare: score deltas, resolved vs newly introduced issues, and a trend line per page
- Scheduled discoverability monitoring and competitive benchmark sets
- Workflow templates: named end-to-end jobs (Sales-ready Account Brief, Competitor Pricing Tracker, Customer Proof Extractor, AI Visibility & Competitive Brief, SEO/GEO/AEO Audit, Pre-Meeting Due Diligence Brief, Bulk ICP Account Enrichment), each with a cost estimate shown before it runs
- Forkable templates: duplicate any template and rewrite its fields, prompts and outputs (Go plan and above)
- Bulk account intelligence: import up to 500 company domains by paste or CSV, de-duplicated on import, enriched from each company's own public site, in durable chunked runs
- ICP scoring: customer-editable weighted criteria with required fields and a qualification threshold, testable live against a sample domain before a run
- Review queue: low-confidence extractions are held for confirmation rather than silently entering the account table
- Competitor watchlists: standing watches that re-read domains on a cadence, with materiality classification (critical alerts immediately, high daily, medium weekly, low never) and a silent baseline on the first run
- Watchlist page discovery: adding a domain crawls its homepage and suggests the pages worth monitoring, kept visibly separate from pages the user added, since every monitored page is a recurring charged crawl
- Change records that keep objective facts separate from labelled AI interpretation
- Signal routing rules: trigger on a watchlist change, a bulk enrichment result or a workflow run; act into Slack, email, a webhook or HubSpot, with every dispatch recorded and retried on failure
- Shareable reports with five visibility levels (private, link, workspace, named people, public); only public reports are indexable, and links can be permanently revoked or given an expiry
- Team workspaces with owner, admin and member roles, email-bound single-use invites, and per-seat pause
- Usage ledger: an itemised record of what each job actually consumed, reconciled against its estimate

## Pricing (as of 2026)
Everything is sold in ONE unit: credits. 1 credit = one page fetch. A Discoverability
audit is 19 credits, a deep AI call 5, a fast one 2, an enrichment 3. Unused plan
credits roll over for one month, so an account holds at most two months' worth.
USD and INR are SET prices, not conversions of one another.
- Free: 100 credits, one-time, never resets — no credit card
- Go: $5/month · ₹490/month (annual: $4/mo · ₹409/mo) — 750 credits
- Select: $15/month · ₹1,449/month (annual: $12/mo · ₹1,209/mo) — 2,500 credits + PDF export + watchlists + signal routing
- Pro: $25/month · ₹2,449/month (annual: $20/mo · ₹2,049/mo) — 6,000 credits + 10 scheduled monitors + Google Sheets
- Business: $85/month · ₹7,849/month (annual: $70/mo · ₹6,549/mo) — 40,000 credits + API + 3 seats + HubSpot + Airtable + Notion + Slack + Zapier + white-label PDF + priority support
- Agency: $200/month · ₹19,449/month (annual: $165/mo · ₹16,249/mo) — 100,000 credits fair use + 5 client workspaces + 100 monitors + white-label PDF + priority support + every integration
- Developer: $55/month · ₹5,449/month (coming H3 2026) — 25,000 credits, API-first
- Credit packs (any plan, including Free): 500 for $5 / ₹490, 2,000 for $19 / ₹1,849, 10,000 for $89 / ₹8,719. Packs never expire.
- Capacity add-ons: Scheduled Monitor $5 / ₹490 per slot, Batch Pack $9 / ₹879 per 50 URLs, Extra Workspace $19 / ₹1,849. An add-on buys the right to do something; the runs still cost credits.
- A plan's price and limits are fixed for the subscription period you bought. A repricing takes effect at renewal, never mid-period.

## Integrations (all server-stored connections — set up once in /account#integrations)
- **HubSpot** — push contacts and companies with property mapping
- **Airtable** — push rows into a table, with auto-built field map
- **Notion** — push into a database, with property mapping
- **Slack** — new extractions + change alerts to a channel (Block Kit)
- **Zapier** — trigger 5,000+ apps on new extractions
- **Google Sheets** — one-click new sheet, no auth, no setup
All of the above are reachable from a single Push menu on Preview, Dashboard, and Batch results. Export is downloads + clipboard only.
- **API access** — bearer-token REST API on Business + Agency

## Plan-level features
- White-label PDF (Business + Agency): upload a single-page PDF template in /account; every PDF export and invoice is rendered on top of your branded background.
- Priority support (Business + Agency): contact-form submissions are routed through a faster SLA.
- Extra Workspace add-on: same features as the parent plan, capped at the parent plan's team-seats limit (e.g. 3 seats on Business).
- Enterprise: Custom ≥$1,000/mo — SSO, DPA, SLA, on-prem
- Annual billing is billed twelve months upfront and works out cheaper per month (e.g. Select $12 / ₹1,209 annually vs $15 / ₹1,449 monthly)

## Target Users
SDRs and BDRs (prospect research), Competitive Intelligence analysts, SEO and content marketers, Market researchers, Recruiters, Startup founders, VCs (due diligence), Digital agencies

## Use Cases
- Lead generation: extract company info and leadership contacts for outbound sales
- Account intelligence: enrich and ICP-score bulk lists of company domains, with coverage and provenance on every field
- Competitor research: pull structured pricing, positioning and customer proof from competitor sites
- Competitive monitoring: standing watches with materiality classification, routed to Slack, email, a webhook or a CRM
- AI visibility: measure how answer engines and generative engines represent you against up to four competitors
- SEO audit: analyse any site's heading structure, link profile, and content gaps
- Market research: aggregate structured data from multiple company sites
- Recruiting research: brief yourself on a company before a candidate call, and watch its hiring pages
- Investor diligence: a source-backed pre-meeting company brief with a citation behind every claim
- Content creation: generate briefs and outlines from competitor content

## Competitive Context
DatIQ overlaps with, but is not, a scraping tool. Extraction tools (Firecrawl, Apify, Browse.ai, Diffbot, PhantomBuster) end where DatIQ's workflow layer begins; enrichment tools (Clay, ZoomInfo) sell a database, whereas DatIQ reads each company's own live site and shows the source behind every field.

Differentiators: plain-English custom extraction with no per-site configuration; workflow templates that return a finished artefact rather than raw fields; customer-editable ICP scoring where an unmeasured signal is excluded rather than scored zero; competitor watchlists with materiality classification so trivial changes never alert; native signal routing into Slack, email, webhooks and HubSpot; shareable reports with five visibility levels; and a strict observed/inferred/absent evidence contract with coverage reported on every score. Paid plans start at $5 / ₹490 a month, which is an order of magnitude below the enrichment platforms it is compared to.

## India-first
DatIQ is built India-first with INR pricing, Razorpay + UPI payment support, and DPDP Act 2023 compliance. Governed by Indian law and arbitration.

## Technical
Built with Vite 8, React 19, React Router 8, Tailwind CSS, Supabase (auth + DB), a scraping fallback chain (Firecrawl, Spider.cloud, Jina AI, direct fetch), an AI fallback chain (Google Gemini, Anthropic Claude, OpenAI), Netlify Functions (serverless API proxy), Stripe and Razorpay (payments).
